subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class provider-family model fallback contract here, and should that contract be wildcard/auto refs, explicit fallbackFamilies groups, or a narrower catalog-derived opt-in?
rationale: The current code supports only flat explicit fallbacks, and adding another fallback source changes public config, provider routing, auth/cost behavior, docs, and upgrade expectations; automation should not choose that contract for maintainers.

options.title: Approve one core fallback contract
options.body: Sponsor a narrow core design, preferably one canonical contract that covers provider-family ordering without adding parallel fallback sources that drift.

options.title: Defer to explicit fallbacks
options.body: Keep the current flat fallbacks contract and improve doctor/docs/model-picker guidance instead of adding new config surface now.

options.title: Route dynamic policy to plugins
options.body: Keep dynamic per-task routing in ClawHub/plugin hooks while only considering core changes for the static provider-family failover gap.

recommendation.title: Approve one core fallback contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a narrow core design, preferably one canonical contract that covers provider-family ordering without adding parallel fallback sources that drift.

likelyOwner.reason: The central fallback resolver history and prior model-routing scope reviews make steipete the best available owner for the product/API direction choice.
